description: This file defines classes, functions, and context managers related to PyTorch's autograd graph, including Node and GradientEdge classes, hooks registration, and backward execution management.

classes.name: Node
classes.description: Abstract base class representing a node in the autograd computation graph, with methods for naming, hooks, and metadata.

classes.name: GradientEdge
classes.description: NamedTuple representing a gradient edge in the autograd graph, linking a Node with output index and ownership token.

classes.name: _Handle
classes.description: Placeholder class used for managing tensor handles in saved tensor hooks.

classes.name: _swap_with_cloned
classes.description: Context manager class for handling tensor cloning during mutation in autograd graph.

classes.name: _AllowMutationOnSavedContext
classes.description: Class storing state for allowing tensor mutation during backward when tensors are saved for backward.

methods.name: _get_grad_fn_or_grad_acc
methods.description: Retrieve the gradient function node or gradient accumulator for a tensor or GradientEdge.

methods.name: get_gradient_edge
methods.description: Construct a GradientEdge object for a tensor, representing its position in the autograd graph.

methods.name: increment_version
methods.description: Update autograd metadata to track in-place modifications of tensors.

methods.name: saved_tensors_hooks
methods.description: Context manager class for setting hooks to customize packing and unpacking of saved tensors.

methods.name: save_on_cpu
methods.description: Context manager for saving tensors on CPU during forward pass to reduce GPU memory usage.

methods.name: disable_saved_tensors_hooks
methods.description: Context manager to disable saved tensor hooks temporarily.

methods.name: set_warn_on_accumulate_grad_stream_mismatch
methods.description: Configure warning behavior for stream mismatches in autograd.

methods.name: register_multi_grad_hook
methods.description: Register a hook that triggers after gradients are computed for multiple tensors, supporting 'all' or 'any' modes.

methods.name: allow_mutation_on_saved_tensors
methods.description: Context manager that permits in-place mutation of tensors saved for backward, cloning them to preserve correctness.
